parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program

ns2:section.sectionText: Section title: “Design Thinking Applied to Leading Organizations.” Section Description: “Using design thinking principles often applied to creating a system of innovation in engineering, this course will apply those principles to the human side of organizations. It will cover the importance of mindset, understanding yourself and others, intentionally creating a trust and support within your teams, and establishing systems for continual learning.” This section is only offered for 1 credit.
